name: properties-panel
title: Properties Panel
author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
description: A Figma-style properties panel with collapsible sections and seven typed control rows — text, number with unit, color, select, toggle, slider, and custom. Config-driven or fully headless.
docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/properties-panel. Pass a sections array to PropertiesPanel for config-driven rendering, or compose PropertiesSection and PropertiesRow directly for headless control. Both modes work simultaneously.
